svg.aria-label: DomoFlow: The receptionist that never sleeps. An AI receptionist on WhatsApp for small hotels and inns in Brazil. It answers guests, quotes rooms and takes bookings, with reservations, payments and room management behind it.

g.text: Hi! Got a room for 2 this weekend?
